detailed_descriptions.en: "VanySlash" The Heroine of the Melee Wizard "Vany" with her Partner Axe "MagnusⅢ" Collect Magic Devices and Fight, Sexy & Hot-Blooded! It is an Action RPG. ■Interaction between the two. In the bar and while on their adventures, Vany and MagnusⅢ chat about all sorts of everyday things. A great adventure while having trivial conversations! ■Order a Quest and Set out! Adjust Vany's Equipment at the Base's Bar and Receive Quests. Let's Advance the Story. Each Quest Provides Costumes and Accessories to Dress up the Vany. Get Magical Tools to Enhance their Actions, Enhance Vany and Magnus. ■Level up with Free Quests! There are Free Quests that you can go Around. You can try out new Outfits and Actions, and earn Experience and Money. ■Various looks! Customization! There are a total of 7 Customization Slots for Costumes and Accessories. There are many Costumes from Sexy to Cool. ■Come On, Let's Go On an Adventure! Sexy & Valor! Action RPG "Vanyslash" Join Vany and Magnus in their Adventures!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
"VanySlash"

The Heroine of the Melee Wizard "Vany" with her Partner Axe "MagnusⅢ"

Collect Magic Devices and Fight, Sexy & Hot-Blooded! It is an Action RPG.

■Interaction between the two.

In the bar and while on their adventures,

Vany and MagnusⅢ chat about all sorts of everyday things.

A great adventure while having trivial conversations!

■Order a Quest and Set out!

Adjust Vany's Equipment at the Base's Bar and Receive Quests.

Let's Advance the Story.

Each Quest Provides Costumes and Accessories to Dress up the Vany.

Get Magical Tools to Enhance their Actions,

Enhance Vany and Magnus.

■Level up with Free Quests!

There are Free Quests that you can go Around.

You can try out new Outfits and Actions, and earn Experience and Money.

■Various looks! Customization!

There are a total of 7 Customization Slots for Costumes and Accessories.

There are many Costumes from Sexy to Cool.

■Come On, Let's Go On an Adventure!

Sexy & Valor! Action RPG "Vanyslash"

Join Vany and Magnus in their Adventures!
